title: Sweep model depth (DEPTH=8 -> 10)
description: Changed DEPTH from 8 to 10 (model_dim auto-scales to 640, 5 heads); no other hyperparameters touched.
reflection: val_bpb improved 1.014027 -> 1.002703, a solid gain from a one-line change. Confirms depth was an under-tuned lever for this time budget; worth a small follow-up grid (e.g. DEPTH=9, 11, 12) to find the local optimum, but diminishing returns and step-time cost should be watched since deeper models take longer per step within the fixed 5-min budget.
